== Walkthrough ==

{{expand}}

''The following information was taken from an allakhazam quest article, it is not presumed to be a functional quest on P99.''

''[[War Historian Kobl]] in the Warrior guild gives this info when hailed:''

: War Historian Kobl says, "You have come to learn? Have you not? I have knowledge of importance to young warriors of the Legion. Or perhaps you are a scribe seeking my [unique writing materials]." When asked about unique writing materials he says:  "You must be a scribe of sorts? Always glad to assist a talented yourth. I make two things unique to Cabilis and important to any future master scribe. I can create [[Blood Ink]] and [[Illweed Parchment]]." 

''On [[Illweed Parchment]]:''  

: War Historian Kobl says, "If you wish to obtain a page of my Illweed Parchment then you only have a simple task to perform. Bring me four Illweed reeds from the Lake of Ill Omen. You may find the only way one can find Illweed is to go fishing."  

''You can in fact get Illweed fishing in the lake.  Bring him four and he will give you an illweed parchment.  I would presume there is a way to write on the Illweed with the ink, but I am not sure.''

<div class='facblock'>
* Your faction with [[Cabilis Residents]] gets better.
* Your faction with [[Crusaders Of Greenmist]] gets better.
* Your faction with [[Legion of Cabilis]] gets better.
* Your faction with [[Scaled Mystics]] gets better.
* Your faction with [[Swift Tails]] gets better.
